title: Interval by Hand
summary: Build a 95% confidence interval from mean, SE and qt(), then check it against t.test().
hints: `m <- mean(x)` and `se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))` (the pre-test has no missing values).
The critical value leaves 2.5% in the upper tail of a t distribution with n − 1 df: `qt(0.975, df = length(x) - 1)`.
`ci_by_hand <- c(m - t_crit * se, m + t_crit * se)`, and `ci_r <- t.test(x)$conf.int`.
